answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a per-identity bond that must be locked before an agent may transact, with a slash for any identity caught farming duplicate work. Honest peers price traffic by bond size, so a thousand clones each need a full bond, and shared funding creates a detectable ripple across the cluster. The marginal cost of adding one more fake identity equals that bond plus expected slash, while the marginal reward stays flat, so a large vine of clones earns no more than one real participant, and sybilling an ocean of agents stays unprofitable.
